changelog:
Initial release of seo-unlighthouse: run Lighthouse audits across multiple URLs locally with Unlighthouse.

- Enables multi-page Lighthouse auditing via Unlighthouse CLI (MIT license).
- Bypasses PageSpeed API quotas; runs entirely offline with Node 18+.
- Supports configurable device emulation, route caps, and custom output directories.
- Simple command routing with rich flag forwarding.
- Aggregates key Lighthouse metrics across all audited routes.
- Designed for easy CI integration and large site coverage.
summary: Multi-page Lighthouse audit via the MIT-licensed Unlighthouse CLI. Free-tier alternative to running PageSpeed against every URL on a site, no API quota burn, runs locally.
